title: Application Support Engineer (ABAP)
description:
Job Title: Application Support Engineer (ABAP)
Location: Hybrid- Irving, Texas 75039
Duration: 6+ Months



POSITION OVERVIEW
The Application Support Engineer (ABAP) will join the Application Managed Services team within Technology Services to deliver and maintain high-quality SAP solutions. This role is focused on driving business process efficiency through robust technical development within the IS-Utilities sector. The mission is to ensure stable, high-performing integration and application support aligned with Client standards.

DAY-TO-DAY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Develop and enhance SAP S/4HANA ABAP solutions for IS-U business processes including Billing, FICA, and Device Management.
  • Design and build custom RICEF objects, CDS Views, OData Services, and Fiori applications.
  • Develop and support integrations using IDocs, RFCs, APIs, CPI, and web services.
  • Analyze business requirements and prepare technical specifications and solution designs.
  • Perform unit testing, defect resolution, production support, and performance optimization.
  • Collaborate with functional teams and ensure adherence to SAP development standards and best practices.
TOP 3 REQUIRED SKILLS
  • S/4 ABAP (8+ years)
  • SAP ISU (8+ years)
  • SAP ABAP Development for HANA (Advanced P3 level)
ADDITIONAL DESIRED SKILLS
  • Experience with Billing, FICA, and Device Management
  • Custom RICEF objects, CDS Views, OData Services, and Fiori applications development
  • Integrations using IDocs, RFCs, APIs, CPI, and web services
  • Technical specification preparation and solution design


IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE :
The ideal candidate is a seasoned SAP professional with over 8 years of specialized experience in S/4 ABAP and SAP IS-Utilities. They possess a strong background in developing custom solutions, building integrations, and optimizing performance in an enterprise environment. They have a collaborative, detail-oriented approach to supporting business-critical functional teams.

title: SAP QM Functional Consultant (Remote)
description:
Job Title: SAP QM Functional Consultant (Remote)
Location: Remote (Hartford, CT Time Zone / EST Preference)
Duration: 6 Months

Visa: Strictly USA Citizens / Green Card Only

Position Overview:
We are seeking an SAP QM Functional Consultant to join our team collaborating on the Sovereign Data S4 Solution project. The client specializes in advanced technology and innovation solutions across multiple industries, and this role focuses on analyzing processes and designing systems to integrate their business model with modern technology.

Day-To-Day Responsibilities:
  • Analyze organization structures and design complex processes and systems within SAP Quality Management (QM).
  • Evaluate the current state of business workflows, gather customer requirements, and define future-state business solutions.
  • Drive the analysis of complex business processes to identify opportunities for improvement and innovation.
  • Research, gather, and synthesize technical information to support strategic data engineering and integration decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless communication and alignment on project goals.
  • Provide expert guidance on best practices and emerging trends within the quality management and integration domains.

Top 3 Required Skills:
  • SAP Quality Management (QM) – Master Proficiency (5+ years)
  • Business Analysis & Systems Design (5+ years)
  • Experience with S/4HANA Solutions / Large-scale ERP implementations (3+ years)

Additional Desired Skills:
  • SAP BTP Integration Suite
  • SAP BTP API Management
  • SAP CPI for Data Services
  • Strong cross-functional team leadership and stakeholder communication

Ideal Candidate Profile:
An expert-level SAP QM Functional Consultant with strong business analysis foundations who thrives in high-visibility technology environments. They should be highly analytical, collaborative, and capable of driving architectural decisions across multiple integrated teams with zero hand-holding.
